title: Product Manager, Schemas
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Schemas is the layer where our customers model their data. It’s a codeless configuration system powering all of Benchling's applications, representing a software abstraction around scientific data and processes. This system enables Benchling to ingest and store data at scale. You own the foundation that the rest of the product, and other Benchling teams, build on.

We’re looking for someone who owns the hard product calls and is the person customers, the field, and engineers come to for the answer, not someone who routes the question to engineering and waits for a reply. You’ll set the direction for the platform primitives, like computed fields, fieldsets, constraints, static properties, and data versioning, that speed up every team building on top of Schemas, and you’ll ship toward that direction incrementally while keeping the platform stable for the admins and developers who depend on it.

The integrated approach is what makes the Benchling platform different. Anything built in Schemas has to work for a wide range of customers and for the other teams building on it, so this role rewards a systems thinker who’s genuinely curious about the science and about how developers and admins actually use the product.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead product management for our Schemas team.

  • Engage with customers, internal teams, and Benchling fields teams to understand their problems-to-solve and use cases.

  • Set the vision for Schemas that will help accelerate development amongst internal development teams.

  • Empower scientists, admins, and computational teams that use Benchling to turn their data into an AI-ready structured data foundation for the entire R&D lifecycle.

  • Comfortable with rapid prototyping, incremental shipping to deliver value to users, while also knowing the need to deliver stable features to our admins and developers. You ensure we ship well-crafted products at a timely pace.

  • Collaborate very closely with Engineering and Design to develop new product capabilities.

  • Partner with Customer Experience, Marketing, and Sales.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to think in systems. Understanding what a customer wants and how that might impact various aspects of our product is essential.

  • Demonstrated ability to have a long term vision and ship incrementally along the way.

  • 6+ years of product management experience

  • Experience with providing technical solutions to internal developers and external customers.

  • Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts to customers and executive leadership.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or Developer Platform industries preferred

  • Demonstrated experience setting direction and influencing stakeholders

  • A strong curiosity around the science processes that power the R&D lifecycle.

  • Past experience working with data modeling or databases required.

HOW WE WORK

Flexible Hybrid Work: We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

#LI-EK1

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
